C1258.title: GPS Spoofing Tool Used to Defraud Freight Platform of Subsidies
C1258.summary: In February 2022, Shanghai Qingpu police cracked a fraud case involving a freight platform. Suspects used third-party software to spoof GPS locations, fabricating completed freight orders to steal coupon subsidies from the platform. By posting fake orders, using cheating tools to simulate locations, and uploading false photos, they accumulated over 20,000 fraudulent orders, involving more than 1 million yuan.

references.title: GPS Spoofing to Fake Location, Earning Coupons While Lying Flat at Home
